name: 10235-mixedprompt-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, sm90, one GPU of an a3 node.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1: one in-process vLLM engine on one card.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder: 32 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, vocab 128256, rope_theta 500000 (llama3 scaling), window 131072, bf16.
load_profile: poisson (open loop), rate = 12 req/s, warmup the first 10% by completed requests, bounded at 1000 requests with a 900 s safety cap. Warmup is 10% rather than the usual 25-30% because the rarest prompt class is 1% of the stream.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no tools: trimodal prompt lengths in an 850 : 140 : 10 mix per 1000 requests -- 8 tokens (stdev 4, [4, 31]), 2900 tokens over 140 distinct prefixes, and 44000 tokens over 10 distinct prefixes. Output length is a clipped gaussian, mean 190, stdev 211, [16, 1024]. Buckets are sampled with replacement, so one draw wobbles around the declared 85/14/1.
purpose: An 8B chat assistant handling a mix of short questions and long shared-prefix documents at twelve requests per second on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line. Values that are this engine's own defaults are written out so a
# later default cannot drift the operating point; every other knob is left at its default.
#
# max-num-batched-tokens is the exception: 512 is NOT this engine's default (it picks 2048). It is
# pinned because the per-step token budget is part of the declared operating point and must not be
# left to a version-dependent default.

model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 131072
enable-chunked-prefill: true
max-num-batched-tokens: 512
enable-prefix-caching: false
